ledger.reason: First run on the new random-target task (goal "target" redrawn every 2 s, policy reads joint encoders + goal, reward = alive + coarse/fine exp distance - near-target speed cost). No policy exists yet; the old fixed-point task could not pass the ot11 spec, so this establishes a baseline against Q1-Q4.
the wall-clock budget of 880 s ran out before the last iteration.

reach-r1 failed Q2 on 10/10 seeds (final_error_arm_lengths_max median 0.82, min 0.43, limit 0.05) and Q3 on 10/10 (never within 7.2 mm, limit 2.0 s); the film shows one fixed pose regardless of target, i.e. the exp(-d/40) reward was flat for the 60-180 mm errors. This run adds a linear distance cost (d/144), sharpens coarse exp to 20 mm, drops the global tip-speed cost and raises the alive bonus to 1.5; expected: the policy conditions on the goal and final errors fall toward the fine-reward scale.
the wall-clock budget of 890 s ran out before the last iteration.

reach-r2 failed Q2 on 9/10 seeds (final_error_arm_lengths_max median 0.099, max 0.26 on 1106, limit 0.05) and hence Q3 on 9/10, with a steady offset short of targets in the film; Q4 failed only on 1107 (0.223 vs 0.20). This run replaces the distance-gated settle cost (which paid to stand off) with an ungated tanh(v/200) cost, raises the fine term to 2*exp(-d/5) and sets entropy 0 so exploration noise shrinks faster than r2's sigma 0.13; expected: final errors fall under 7.2 mm. (Warm start from r2 was not possible: its parent task bundle could not be located.)
the wall-clock budget of 890 s ran out before the last iteration.

reach-r3 failed Q2 on 10/10 seeds (final_error_arm_lengths_max median 0.139, max 0.307 on 1106, limit 0.05), Q3 on 10/10 and Q4 on 1107 (0.301) and 1109 (0.238); its settle_cost sat at its 0.3/step ceiling and control cost implied ~120 N*mm RMS force vs ~35 N*mm gravity hold, i.e. the policy chatters. This run makes the tip-speed cost linear (v/500), raises the force-squared cost to 1e-5 and moves joint rates to privileged so the policy cannot learn chattering rate feedback; expected: a quiet hold and final errors under 7.2 mm.
the wall-clock budget of 895 s ran out before the last iteration.
